radii.source: radii: NAIF pck00011.tpc (IAU WGCCRE 2015); mean radius: JPL planetary/satellite physical parameters

albedo.tintRef: white balance of the Voyager 2 colour composite (its violet/green/orange filters give the map a green cast): per-channel factors that turn the map's mean linear colour (0.4385, 0.4709, 0.3323, planet-bake albedo-means before the balance) into the disc-integrated colour B-V 0.70 +- 0.01 (Pascu et al., HST BVI photometry of Triton; Buratti et al. 1994, Icarus 110, for its secular colour changes): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - 0.65)) = 0.9550, rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110) = 1.0384 (no V-R used: the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength, as for Europa)
